title: Using a fixed dosage of follitropin delta for ovarian stimulation for intrauterine insemination.
official:
Using a fixed dosage of follitropin delta for ovarian stimulation for intrauterine insemination.
Rekovelle for Intrauterine Successful Experience (RISE )
summary: Main objective: To observe the effect of a fixed dose of follitropin delta (3.66mcg) on the ovarian response during ovarian stimulation for IUI.

interventions.name: REKOVELLE 36 micrograms/1.08 mL solution for injection in a pre-filled pen
Ovitrelle 250 micrograms solution for injection in pre-filled pen
REKOVELLE 12 micrograms/0.36 mL solution for injection in a pre-filled pen
UTROGESTAN 200 mg, capsule molle orale ou vaginale

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Normo-ovulatory patients
2. 18 – 38 included years old
3. BMI between 18 and 29 included kg/m²
4. Regular menstrual cycles
5. At least one healthy Fallopian tube
6. Normal uterus cavity
7. First treatment for IUI
8. Affiliation to the social security
Exclusion criteria:
1. Endometriosis Stage III
2. Tumors (including meningioma) whose development is known or suspected to be progesterone-dependent
3. History of hepatic dysfunction
4. Severe spermatogenesis disorders
5. Have been receiving progestogen therapy for more than 6 months
6. Known contraindication to hormonal treatments (progestogens or oestrogens), or  with a history of adverse events related to their use.
7. Previous thromboembolism events during or following the use of gonadotrophins or with high risk factors for thromboembolic events (venous or arterial)
8. Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients
9. High risk of OHSS such as women with AMH ≥ 35 pmol/L
10. History of severe uterine malformation (unicornuate or bicornuate uterus)
11. Past history of ovarian torsion
12. Gynecological bleeding of unknown etiology
13. Uncontrolled thyroid dysfunction
14. Uncontrolled adrenal dysfunction
15. Hydrosalpynx
16. Women with Poly Cystic Ovary Syndrom
17. Breast pathologies not compatible with gonadotrophin stimulation
18. Use of infertility medications that could affect follicle stimulation and maturation such as GH
19. History of OHSS or excessive response to gonadotrophins
20. Chronic disease with contraindication to ovarian stimulation with gonadotrophins
21. Known genetic disease
22. Hypothalamus or pituitary tumors
23. Ovarian, uterine or breast carcinoma
24. Ovarian hypertrophy or ovarian cyst not due to polycystic ovary syndrome
25. Not able to understand and sign the written informed consent form
26. Previous or current treatment with gonadotrophins
27. Primary ovarian failure
28. Genital malformations incompatible with pregnancy
29. Uterine fibroids incompatible with pregnancy
30. Protected persons (pregnant women, nursing mothers, person under guardianship, minors, persons deprived of liberty, and persons unable to give consent)
31. Participation in other interventional research
32. Total mobile sperm count <1 million
